meta.description: Manifest v2: everything install.py needs to restore this system on bare Arch. Package lists are generated from pacman ground truth (pacman -Qqen / -Qqem) with the GNOME stack excluded.
notes: google-chrome chosen over google-chrome-bin (they conflict, only one can be installed).
Noctalia Shell (noctalia-git + quickshell) replaces waybar/rofi/wofi UI, so those are not listed.
GNOME + GDM are installed on the source machine but deliberately excluded from restore; SDDM is the display manager for fresh installs.
Entries are either a plain string or {name, reason}. install.py only needs the name.
Run `python3 install.py check` after Arch repo changes — packages migrate between AUR and official repos over time.

pacman.name: nvidia-utils
pacman.reason: dep of nvidia-open-dkms; pinned explicitly so the driver userspace is always present

pacman.name: vulkan-icd-loader
pacman.reason: Vulkan loader; explicit so GPU stack is complete without relying on dep resolution

pacman.name: lib32-nvidia-utils
pacman.reason: provider pin: steam needs a lib32 OpenGL driver and --noconfirm would otherwise pick lib32-mesa on an NVIDIA machine

pacman.name: lib32-vulkan-icd-loader
pacman.reason: 32-bit Vulkan loader for Steam/Proton games

pacman.name: pipewire
pacman.reason: audio server; dep-installed via GNOME on source machine, must be explicit on a GNOME-free install

pacman.name: pipewire-pulse
pacman.reason: PulseAudio compat; same reason as pipewire

pacman.name: wireplumber
pacman.reason: PipeWire session manager; same reason as pipewire

pacman.name: bluez
pacman.reason: bluetooth.service is enabled; dep-installed via GNOME on source machine

pacman.name: bluez-utils
pacman.reason: bluetoothctl CLI — GNOME's bluetooth panel won't exist on the fresh install

pacman.name: quickshell
pacman.reason: runtime for Noctalia Shell (qs CLI)

pacman.name: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
pacman.reason: replaces xdg-desktop-portal-gnome; hyprland package ships hyprland-portals.conf that selects it

pacman.name: xdg-desktop-portal-gtk
pacman.reason: fallback portal for file pickers / settings, paired with the hyprland portal

pacman.name: wtype
pacman.reason: voxtype's default text-output driver

pacman.name: libnotify
pacman.reason: notify-send used by hypr scripts/binds; dep-installed via GNOME on source machine

pacman.name: polkit
pacman.reason: privilege prompts; dep-installed via GNOME on source machine

pacman.name: gnome-keyring
pacman.reason: kept despite GNOME exclusion — secrets/SSH agent under Hyprland (user socket is enabled)

pacman.name: xdg-user-dirs
pacman.reason: replaces xdg-user-dirs-gtk (GNOME variant)

pacman.name: nautilus
pacman.reason: file manager bound in hypr binds.lua

pacman.name: sushi
pacman.reason: nautilus previewer

pacman.name: npm
pacman.reason: needed for npm_global packages below

pacman.name: ttf-liberation
pacman.reason: baseline font fallback (also a steam dependency)

pacman.name: noto-fonts
pacman.reason: unicode text fallback — on the source machine fallback fonts arrive via GNOME deps

pacman.name: noto-fonts-emoji
pacman.reason: emoji fallback; dep-installed via GNOME on source machine

pacman.name: solaar
pacman.reason: Logitech device manager, config tracked in repo

pacman.name: evolution
pacman.reason: mail client — deliberate keep despite GNOME lineage

pacman.name: docker
pacman.reason: installed but docker.service intentionally NOT enabled — started manually when needed

pacman.name: virtualbox-host-dkms
pacman.reason: provider pin: --noconfirm would otherwise pick virtualbox-host-modules-arch, but this machine runs DKMS modules

aur.name: noctalia-git
aur.reason: the desktop shell (replaced noctalia-qs, which was removed)

aur.name: paru
aur.reason: second AUR helper, used alongside yay

aur.name: voxtype
aur.reason: push-to-talk dictation (plain package, NOT voxtype-cuda). Launched by Hyprland exec-once — never enable voxtype.service

optional.name: loupe
optional.reason: GNOME image viewer — useful standalone, install with --with-optional

optional.name: hyprpolkitagent
optional.reason: polkit agent for Hyprland — no agent runs today (polkit-gnome exec-once is commented out in system.lua)

optional.name: ibus
optional.reason: input method framework; explicitly installed once but now only a GNOME dep, unclear if used under Hyprland

removed_do_not_install.name: datagrip
removed_do_not_install.reason: installed then removed (paru -Rdd) — final state: not installed

removed_do_not_install.name: yay-debug
removed_do_not_install.reason: makepkg debug artifact, never install explicitly

removed_do_not_install.name: voxtype-cuda
removed_do_not_install.reason: only test-cloned once; the plain voxtype package is what's actually used

user_do_not_enable.name: voxtype.service
user_do_not_enable.reason: Hyprland exec-once launches voxtype; running both crash-loops ('another voxtype instance is already running')

groups.name: input
groups.reason: voxtype needs evdev access for the push-to-talk hotkey

wallpapers.compat_reason: hypr wallpaper scripts and noctalia settings.json reference the singular path

sync_policy.description: Rules used by `install.py sync` to regenerate pacman[]/aur[] from live pacman state.
